  • Harmony 360 Health is a physician-led integrative medicine clinic in Ibadan, Nigeria, helping adults and children address the underlying factors affecting their health through modern medicine, lifestyle medicine, advanced diagnostics, and evidence-informed natural therapies.

     

    Operations Officer

    • Job Type Full Time , Onsite
    • Qualification BA/BSc/HND , MBA/MSc/MA
    • Experience 3 years
    • Location Oyo
    • Job Field Administration / Facilities  , Medical / Healthcare 

    Harmony 360 Health Ibadan is a growing integrative healthcare and wellness company preparing to launch its first facility in Ibadan. Our mission is to help individuals achieve better health and live more meaningful lives through whole-person healthcare.

    We are seeking an experienced, resourceful, and highly organized Operations Officer to take ownership of our day-to-day administrative and operational activities.

    This is a hands-on role for someone who can work independently, coordinate people and processes, solve problems, and ensure that tasks are completed without constant supervision.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Oversee daily administrative and operational activities at the facility.
    • Coordinate facility setup, vendors, suppliers, contractors, and service providers.
    • Manage operational tasks, timelines, procurement, and follow-up to ensure timely completion.
    • Develop, implement, and maintain administrative processes, SOPs, and documentation.
    • Support staff onboarding, scheduling, and coordination.
    • Maintain accurate operational records, track expenses, and prepare regular reports.
    • Identify operational gaps, troubleshoot problems, and recommend practical solutions.
    • Serve as the primary point of coordination between the on-site team and the Founder/Medical Director.
    • Support the smooth launch and ongoing operations of H360's healthcare and wellness services.

    Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Management, or a related field.
    • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in operations, administration, facility coordination, or a similar role.
    • Demonstrated experience independently managing tasks, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and delivering results.
    • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    • Proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, particularly spreadsheets, shared documents, and reporting tools.
    • Ability to prioritize competing demands and work effectively with minimal supervision.
    • Strong sense of accountability, professionalism, and attention to detail.
    • Added advantage: Previous experience in healthcare operations, a growing business, or managing the setup of a new facility.

    Who Will Thrive in This Role?

    Someone who:

    • Takes ownership of problems and follows through until they are resolved.
    • Anticipates operational needs rather than waiting for instructions.
    • Can turn broad objectives into actionable tasks and timelines.
    • Communicates progress, challenges, and solutions clearly.
    • Is comfortable building systems in an evolving organization.

    What We Offer

    An opportunity to play a meaningful role in building a growing healthcare organization, with potential for increased responsibility as the company expands.

    Method of Application

    Send your CV and a brief cover letter to: careers@harmony360health.com Email subject: Application – Operations Officer
